name: Warren Parks & Recreation Summer Camp
description_short: Town-run, electronics-free traditional day camp for ages 5-14 at Burr's Hill Park, 9am-3pm with extended hours 7-9am and 3-5pm. Activities include arts and crafts, games, bowling, weekly contests, swimming and field trips, and campers get a free summer lunch.
